Package com.j3d.engine.interact.cmd.base

Class Command

java.lang.Object
com.j3d.engine.interact.cmd.base.Command
Direct Known Subclasses:
CameraCmd, ClipboardCmd, CreateCmd, DebugCmd, EngineCmd, ExplodeCmd, ExtrudeCmd, HelpCmd, JaivaExecCmd, JoinCmd, MacroCmd, MeasureCmd, PrismCmd, SelectCmd, Subcommand, ThingCmd, TransformCmd, UICmd
public class Command extends Object
A Command encapsulates all the information needed to define and execute a user-callable action. This includes its name, aliases, description, and a structured list of accepted Arguments.

Key responsibilities of this class include:

  • Defining the command's identity and structure.
  • Providing a run(com.j3d.engine.interact.cmd.Invoker, com.j3d.ui.SafeJLabel, java.lang.String, java.lang.Object[], java.util.ArrayList<com.j3d.engine.interact.cmd.args.TaggedArgValue<?>>) method for subclasses to implement their specific logic.
  • Supporting a hierarchy of commands through subcommand dispatching.
  • A mechanism (parseUsages()) to automatically generate detailed usage strings based on its arguments, which is crucial for providing dynamic help and command suggestions to the user.
Author:
Lehlogonolo Poole
